item.title: What kind of mistakes should never be made in the cryptocurrency market?
item.description: If you followed the investment advice of the BlackRock CEO and went long on Bitcoin yesterday, you would have probably learned your lesson from the market today. Today, let’s take a look at how Levermore, more than a hundred years ago, fell victim to trusting the views of the big shots and ended up losing money.
